'''Amadaine 10 (June 17)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - [[Rand]], [[Hurin]], and [[Loial]] wake to find themselves in a [[Portal Stone|strange new world]]. They decide to follow the [[Darkfriend]] trail.
*{{ne|998}} - [[Ingtar Shinowa|Ingtar's]] party wake to find Rand and the others gone. [[Perrin]] becomes Ingtar's new "[[sniffer]]." As they find another massacred village, [[Verin]] arrives and joins the party.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Rand]] and the [[Aiel]] leave [[Imre Stand]].
*{{ne|999}} - Perrin and his men destroy another party of [[Trolloc]]s and a [[Fade]].
